description: Defines the PointerControllerInterface class for tracking and controlling mouse/touchpad pointers and spots in Android input system.

classes.name: PointerControllerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing pointer and touchpad spot behavior, including movement, visibility, presentation modes, and display viewport settings.

methods.name: getBounds
methods.description: Returns the bounds of the region that the pointer can traverse, if available.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves the pointer by specified delta values.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the absolute position of the pointer.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current absolute position of the pointer.

methods.name: fade
methods.description: Fades the pointer out immediately or gradually based on the transition parameter.

methods.name: unfade
methods.description: Makes the pointer visible if it has faded out, with specified transition.

methods.name: setPresentation
methods.description: Sets the display mode of the pointer (e.g., POINTER, SPOT, STYLUS_HOVER).

methods.name: setSpots
methods.description: Sets the spots for the current gesture, representing finger positions.

methods.name: getDisplayId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the display where the pointer is shown.

methods.name: setDisplayViewport
methods.description: Associates a display viewport with the pointer.
